data.theme.properties:
# Emrys Health login theme in the HDRS palette. Inherits everything from the
# stock keycloak.v2 theme except the stylesheet list: a child's `styles` replaces
# (does not append to) the parent's, so css/styles.css is re-declared to keep
# the v2 base styling, with css/hdrs.css layered on top.
parent=keycloak.v2
styles=css/styles.css css/hdrs.css

# Pin the light card: HDRS's purple/cream scheme is the intended look regardless
# of the user's OS dark-mode preference.
darkMode=false

command:

  echo "waiting for OIDC issuer $DISCOVERY_URL"

command:
set -e
if [ -f /state/already-bootstrapped ]; then
  echo 'Polaris realm POLARIS already bootstrapped, skipping'
  exit 0
fi
java -jar /deployments/polaris-admin-tool.jar bootstrap -r POLARIS -c "POLARIS,$POLARIS_ID,$POLARIS_SECRET"
container.name: bootstrap

command:
set -e
until pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER"; do echo 'waiting for postgres'; sleep 2; done
psql -d postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='$POLARIS_DB'" | grep -q 1 \
  || psql -d postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE \"$POLARIS_DB\""
if [ "$(psql -d "$POLARIS_DB" -tAc "SELECT to_regclass('polaris_schema.entities')")" = 'polaris_schema.entities' ]; then
  touch /state/already-bootstrapped
fi
echo 'polaris db ready'
init_container.name: db-create
